review.notes: Clean apart from one structural heading. All 8 physical PDF pages were compared line-by-line against the OCR (normalized word-presence diff found no dropped content, including all reference entries and URLs); physical pages 1, 3, 4 and 5 were rendered (120 dpi) plus a 300 dpi crop to verify repairs and every table value. Tables 1-4 in the OCR match the rendered values exactly, including em-dash empty cells. The PDF prints GROK/GROK IMAGINE/GROK 4.2 SA in small capitals (verified on the page-1 render), so the OCR's uppercase transcription is faithful and was not patched; "CloningScenarios" is printed without a space in the source (verified at 300 dpi, three occurrences) and was kept; the sentence "We report results for GROK 4.2 SA on the MASK dataset in Table 4." reproduces the source's own cross-reference wording even though the MASK results appear in Table 2, so it was kept. No embedded figures exist in the PDF.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.1 title block prints three centered lines: "Grok 4.20 System Card", "xAI", "April 7, 2026"; OCR kept the first two but promoted the date line to a duplicate H1 section heading. Demoted to plain text; the numbered section headings remain the only headings.
